parsed.note_claim: Per official guidance issued on behalf of King Charles, Harry and Meghan are private citizens whose charitable work is undertaken in a private capacity and does not represent the Sovereign.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The charitable work of the Duke and Duchess is a personal matter for them both and undertaken in their private capacity. In short, their position is akin to private citizens with commercial and charitable interests.
parsed.reason: The page quotes the Lord Chamberlain's letter on behalf of King Charles directly confirming Harry and Meghan are not working royals, their charitable work is undertaken in a private capacity, and their position is akin to private citizens.
